text: Ahmed Jamal, born on 3 September 1988, is a Pakistani first-class cricketer who plays for Sui Southern Gas Company. He stands at six feet four inches (193 cm) and is a right-arm pace bowler. In October 2017, he achieved his career-best bowling figures by taking nine wickets for 50 runs against Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited in the 2017–18 Quaid-e-Azam Trophy while representing Sui Southern Gas Corporation. Jamal gained recognition by winning Pakistan’s “King of Speed” competition in 2013, where he recorded a bowling speed of 143 km/h.
